title: Align cleanup roles and in-use safeguards across instructions and test documentation
outcome: Agents receive consistent cleanup ownership and in-use/path safeguards when reading standing instructions or docs/test.md.
acceptance: The cleanup role wording in docs/test.md and the standing instructions is consistent, while existing active-claim, process, run-evidence and path/reparse protections remain intact.

The documentation explicitly states which in-use and reparse-point safeguards apply to whole-worktree removal as well as build-output removal, without granting automatic deletion or weakening existing retention protections.
Any instruction or authority-text change follows the existing exact-wording concurrence, Greg-notification and final-diff audit requirements.
